question: Who among of the following is the author of the book Making India Awesome?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chetan Bhagat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Making India Awesome is written by the famous **Indian Novelist Chetan Bhagat.**
 
• His popular novels include **Five Point Someone, The 3 Mistakes of My Life, and Half Girlfriend.**
 
• He has also written non-fictional books like **What Young India Wants**.
 
• He has been listed in** Time Magazine's list of the** "**100 Most Influential People in the World".**
